rules.coverage_text: Residential rental properties in California not otherwise exempted.

exemptions.description: Housing with certificate of occupancy within previous 15 years
exemptions.quote: Housing that has been issued a certificate of occupancy within the previous 15 years, unless the housing is a mobilehome.

exemptions.description: Shares bathroom/kitchen with owner who lives there
exemptions.quote: Housing accommodations in which the tenant shares bathroom or kitchen facilities with the owner who maintains their principal residence at the residential real property.

exemptions.description: Separately alienable property with non-corporate owner and notice

key_values.name: relocation_assistance
key_values.text: equal to one month of the tenant's rent

rules.penalty: Notice void; actual damages, attorney's fees, up to three times actual damages if willful; injunctive relief.
rules.quote: after a tenant has continuously and lawfully occupied a residential real property for 12 months, the owner of the residential real property shall not terminate a tenancy without just cause, which shall be stated in the written notice to terminate tenancy.
relations_hint: Residential real property subject to a local ordinance requiring just cause for termination of a residential tenancy adopted on or before September 1, 2019, in which case the local ordinance shall apply.
rules.requirement: After a tenant has lawfully occupied a unit for 12 months, the owner may terminate only for stated at-fault or no-fault just cause. No-fault terminations require relocation assistance or a final-month rent waiver equal to one month's rent.
tenancy_conditions: tenant has continuously and lawfully occupied for 12 months (or 24 months if adult tenants added)
rules.title: Just cause required for termination after 12 months
